note: Manual labels: each of the 50 sampled misses (tools/failures.py, answer not in the top 10, random seed 0) was read - statement, gold solution, returned #1 - and given ONE primary cause. Judgement, not a measurement.

categories.shared_technique: The gold solution uses a very common pattern (DP, DFS, bisect, sort + greedy, gcd). The #1 solves a different problem with the same pattern: the code vector matches the technique, not the task.
categories.closed_form: A short solution that encodes a mathematical insight the statement never names (e.g. print((n-1)//2) for a story about schools). Almost nothing in the code connects to the story.
categories.scaffolding: Contest template, debug helpers or long comments swamp the few lines of actual logic the encoder should see.
categories.unreadable: The gold is not readable code (base64 + exec).
categories.library_idiom: The gold solves the task through an unusual library (networkx / numpy) rather than the algorithm the statement implies.
categories.non_english: The statement is not in English; the encoder is an English model.
